lines.en: Sssss, shuffling steps.
Clank, closing in.
Rumbling forward, frenzied steps.
Glittering eyes, ravenous gaze.
Grinding teeth, gnawing chains.

lines.zh: 我的铁链在俯瞰堡垒里拖出响声。
lines.en: My chains drag loudly through the overlook fortress.
Sssss, creeping closer.
Waving staff, sssss.
Licking chain, agitated.
Grinning, growling, closing in.
Chain rattle, endless teeth grinding.

lines.zh: 王座空了，我还跪在台阶下。
lines.en: The throne is empty; I still kneel below the steps.
Scanning, aimless wandering.
Head down, sssss.
Grinning, mumbling sssss.
Chain falling, frenzied hiss.
Mumbling, sssss.
Staring, eyes blazing.
Grinning, sssss.
Staring, frenzied hiss.
I count the cracks in the altar.

lines.zh: 我把仪式匕首擦了又擦。
lines.en: I wipe the ritual dagger again and again.

lines.zh: 我对着空王座跪了下去。
lines.en: I kneel to an empty throne.

lines.zh: 我在墙上刻下第七道痕。
lines.en: I carve a seventh mark into the wall.

lines.zh: 我在祭坛边低声数拍子。
lines.en: I count the beats under my breath by the altar.

lines.zh: 我把暗钢苦无排成一列。
lines.en: I line up my darksteel kunai in a row.
Fixing gaze, eyes blazing.
Staring at player, sssss.
Growling, sssss, closing in.
Eyes like torches, player afraid.
The leader went mad, and I chant along.
Sssss, player trapped.
Eyes like torches, threaten.
Sssss, player scared.
Growling, closing in.
I crane my neck at a wrong angle.
I study you through my visor.
My laugh stops halfway.
I point at you, then at the altar.

lines.zh: 我把你的名字写进祭单。
lines.en: I write your name on the offering list.
There is more white than pupil in my eyes.
The mad cultist wails and falls.
The mad cultist roars and trembles.
The mad cultist's scream abruptly stops.
He struggles in agony.
The mad cultist howls in agony.
The mad cultist wails in pain.
The mad cultist struggles in pain.
The mad cultist wails and collapses.
He groans in pain.
The mad cultist moans in pain.

lines.zh: 你散发的香气引来了我的注意。
lines.en: You emit a scent that catches my attention.

lines.zh: 我的信仰因你的异教而扭曲。
lines.en: My faith twists due to your heresy.

lines.zh: 你身上有种我不理解的魔力。
lines.en: Something magical about you puzzles me.

lines.zh: 仪式需要活祭品来强化。
lines.en: Rituals require live sacrifices.

lines.zh: 邪教的教义使我越来越疯狂。
lines.en: My madness grows with cult teachings.

lines.zh: 你的灵魂将会是我新的信徒。
lines.en: Your soul will be a new follower.

lines.zh: 仪式中你将会感受到痛苦。
lines.en: Pain will be felt during the ritual.

lines.zh: 邪教徒间的竞争从未停止。
lines.en: Competition among cultists never ceases.

lines.zh: 我必须找到你并将其消灭。
lines.en: I must find you and destroy you.

lines.zh: 你的力量可以增强我的仪式。
lines.en: Your power enhances my ritual.

lines.zh: 你踩到了祭坛的刻线，退后。
lines.en: You stepped on the altar's carved line; back away.
I need to knock you away.

lines.zh: 撞墙的声音会让我变得更疯狂。
lines.en: Colliding with walls makes me crazier.

lines.zh: 我的匕首已经磨得能照出脸。
lines.en: My dagger is polished enough to show a face.

lines.zh: 你离我的视线越来越近。
lines.en: You get closer to my sight.

lines.zh: 我的护甲可以抵挡你的攻击。
lines.en: My armor can withstand your attacks.

lines.zh: 碰撞后我感到更加激昂。
lines.en: Collision makes me more frenzied.

lines.zh: 你无法阻止我前进的脚步。
lines.en: You can't stop my advancing footsteps.

lines.zh: 我将用我的力量粉碎你。
lines.en: I will crush you with my strength.
There will be no peace between us.

lines.zh: 我们之间的结合将使我们更强。
lines.en: Our union will make us stronger.

lines.zh: 我需要你作为我的伴侣。
lines.en: I need you as my mate.
You will be my future mate.
We will unite during the ritual.

lines.zh: 我的信仰需要你的力量。
lines.en: My faith needs your power.

lines.zh: 你的存在是对我的考验。
lines.en: Your presence is a test for me.

lines.zh: 让我们一起完成我们的使命。
lines.en: Let's complete our mission together.
I will protect you forever.

lines.zh: 我们是同类，注定要在一起。
lines.en: We are kindred spirits, destined to be together.

lines.zh: 我们的结合将超越常规。
lines.en: Our union will transcend the norm.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，腐烂的手指抓向你！
lines.en: Sssss! Corrupted fingers reaching for you!

lines.zh: 你感到一股邪能涌向内心！
lines.en: You feel corruptive power surging within!

lines.zh: 干枯的舌头舔过你的脸庞！
lines.en: Dry tongue licks your face!

lines.zh: 狂笑不止，癫狂的灵魂在嘶吼！
lines.en: Insane laughter never ceases!

lines.zh: 腐朽的牙齿咬破你的皮肤！
lines.en: Decayed teeth bite your skin!
You smell the stench of death!

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指撕裂你的衣服！
lines.en: Decaying fingers tear your clothes!
Maniacal eyes fixate on you!
You can't escape his grasp!
Cursed by the cultist!

lines.zh: 腐朽之心，终于找到猎物！
lines.en: 腐朽之心, finally found prey!

lines.zh: 邪教徒的信徒，来接受审判！
lines.en: Cultist's acolyte, receive judgment!
Your soul belongs to the dark gods!

lines.zh: 腐烂的双手抓住你的心脏！
lines.en: Decaying hands clutch your heart!

lines.zh: 首领疯了，我也跟着疯了。
lines.en: My master went mad, and I went with him.

lines.zh: 邪教徒的诅咒，永世难逃！
lines.en: Cursed by the cultist, forever!
You will be punished!
Dark ritual begins!

lines.zh: 邪教徒的追随者，今夜灭亡！
lines.en: Cultist's followers, tonight you die!

lines.zh: 你的死亡将为教派赎罪！
lines.en: Your death will atone for the cult!
Believer, you have been chosen.
The offering walked into the fortress itself.
The leader went mad, and so did I.

lines.zh: 你的血能补全这场仪式。
lines.en: Your blood completes the rite.
The sect scattered; only I keep the vigil.
You stepped in the ash of the holy altar.
Tonight is short one living soul.
My blade tip is already aimed at you.
Maniacal incantation, target locked!
Dark god's wrath, about to erupt!

lines.zh: 仪式刀磨好了，堡垒就是祭坛。
lines.en: The ritual knife is sharp; this bastion is my altar.

lines.zh: 邪教徒的诅咒，准备降临！
lines.en: Cursed by the cultist, ready to fall!

lines.zh: 钟敲第三下，我的咒也念完。
lines.en: On the third bell, my incantation ends.

lines.zh: 邪教徒的审判，你将承受！
lines.en: Cultist's judgment, you shall bear!
Dark magic devours you!

lines.zh: 邪教徒的诅咒，将你缠绕！
lines.en: Cursed by the cultist, you are ensnared!
Death's curse, ready to unleash!

lines.zh: 邪教徒的复仇，你将承受！
lines.en: Cultist's revenge, you will bear!
I circle the altar counterclockwise.

lines.zh: 我念咒的节奏越来越快。
lines.en: My chanting quickens.
I slip a kunai between my fingers.
Your hamstrings first.
I wait for the third bell.
I draw a circle on the floor with my dagger.
My steps never falter.
I have pinned your shadow down.

lines.zh: 我从雕像的影子里挪近。
lines.en: I edge closer from the statue's shadow.
I press my breathing to the lightest hush.

lines.zh: 狂热教徒嘶吼着冲向你！
lines.en: The mad cultist roars and charges at you!

lines.zh: 疯狂的仪式刀在空中划出弧线！
lines.en: The ritual dagger arcs through the air!

lines.zh: 他挥舞着苦无向你袭来！
lines.en: He swings his shiv at you!

lines.zh: 邪教护甲嘎吱作响，他扑向你！
lines.en: The cultist armor creaks as he lunges at you!

lines.zh: 他用尖锐的嘶吼撕裂空气！
lines.en: He rips the air with a sharp howl!

lines.zh: 他的眼睛燃烧着疯狂的火焰！
lines.en: His eyes burn with madness!

lines.zh: 苦无闪烁着阴冷的光芒！
lines.en: The shiv glows with cold light!

lines.zh: 狂热的咆哮充满了仇恨和绝望！
lines.en: A mad roar filled with hate and despair!

lines.zh: 他挥舞着匕首，向你发起攻击！
lines.en: He swings the dagger at you!

lines.zh: 他的邪教护甲闪烁着恶兆！
lines.en: His cultist armor glows with ill omen!

lines.zh: 苦无擦着你的耳廓飞过！
lines.en: A kunai grazes past your ear!

lines.zh: 我把仪式匕首捅进甲缝！
lines.en: I slip the ritual dagger into a seam of your armor!
I grab your collar and shriek!

lines.zh: 暗钢划开一道长长的口子！
lines.en: Darksteel opens one long, red line!

lines.zh: 狂热教徒从破碎的祭坛中爬出！
lines.en: The mad cultist crawls from the broken altar!

lines.zh: 邪教的信徒在废墟中出现！
lines.en: A cultist appears in the ruins!

lines.zh: 一个狂热教徒出现在祭坛旁！
lines.en: A mad cultist appears next to the altar!

lines.zh: 从废墟的阴影中走出一个狂热教徒！
lines.en: A mad cultist walks out from the shadow of the ruins!

lines.zh: 狂热教徒从倒塌的雕像后现身！
lines.en: The mad cultist appears behind the fallen statue!

lines.zh: 一个狂热教徒从祭坛的裂缝中冒出来！
lines.en: A mad cultist pops out from the altar's crack!

lines.zh: 邪教的信徒在破碎的祭坛前出现！
lines.en: A cultist appears before the broken altar!

lines.zh: 狂热教徒从废弃的祭坛中走出！
lines.en: A mad cultist walks out from the abandoned altar!

lines.zh: 从祭坛的废墟中走出一个狂热教徒！
lines.en: A mad cultist walks out from the rubble of the altar!

lines.zh: 狂热教徒从祭坛的裂缝中爬出！
lines.en: The mad cultist crawls out from the altar's crack!

lines.zh: 俯瞰堡垒的钟又响一声。
lines.en: The bell of the overlook fortress rings once more.

lines.zh: 火盆亮起，我站在位子上。
lines.en: Braziers flare and I take my place.
I count my steps on the broken stair.
The blood on the altar is not dry yet.
In the shadows I begin to chant.
I drag a rusted chain across the flagstones.

lines.zh: 教派的最后一盏灯亮了。
lines.en: The sect's last lamp lights up.
I step out from behind the drapery.

lines.zh: 疯掉的我从王座下站起。
lines.en: Mad, I rise from beneath the throne.

lines.zh: 供桌上多了一具我的影子。
lines.en: One more of my shadows lies on the offering table.
The flames burn his skin.
He falls and gets injured from a height.
The water drowned him.
The explosion tears his flesh.
An arrow pierces his heart.
Magic burns his soul.
Starvation wastes his muscles.
Lightning strikes his heart.
The void tears his body.
